author: The Infographics Show
description:
People didn’t suddenly stop wanting families, they stopped being able to afford the life that once made having one feel possible.

This video explores why the American family is shrinking, and why blaming feminism, Gen Z, or changing cultural values misses the bigger picture. Housing costs have exploded, wages have fallen behind productivity, childcare can rival a mortgage payment, student debt delays major life milestones, and mothers still face a major earnings penalty after having children. The same pattern is appearing across the developed world. Countries like South Korea, Japan, and Hungary have spent billions on baby bonuses, tax breaks, and parental incentives, yet fertility rates remain far below replacement level.
The problem isn’t that young people stopped wanting children, it’s that family life became a luxury.

title: It's Not Feminism. The American Family is DEAD.
